Irene: Creating RC for small hotfix on token-allocator. RC id rc-fjord-5987. Holding a 15m quiet window; need one QE + RM ack.

deploy-bot: Candidate created: rc-fjord-5987 | image: registry.redwood/serve:sha256:1122aabb | pinned=true | start canary: `/deploy promote rc-fjord-5987 --to=canary --traffic=5%`.

Tom: Ack. Running quick smoke (20 requests) and basic correctness checks. ETA 6m.

Carlos: Infra green. GPU pool available, PVs mounted. KV prewarm set to +30s after canary.

Tom: Smoke: PASS. No errors, p50 improved ~6ms. snippet: `200 OK` from all pods.

Irene: Abort criteria: error rate > 1% sustained 2m OR p95 jump > 120ms. Rollback snippet for notes:
```bash
# rollback
/deploy rollback promo-5987001 --to=stable
/gcr unpin registry.redwood/serve:sha256:1122aabb
```

ReleaseBot: Quiet window active for 15m. Critical alerts still escalate.

Irene: If 5% holds for 10m, we'll ramp to 25% over 8m. RM conditional signoff given pending 10m stability.

deploy-bot: Action queued: `/deploy start rc-fjord-5987 --traffic=5% --kv-warm=true`

Tom: 12m update: canary stable, telemetry normal. proceeding to ramp: `/deploy promote rc-fjord-5987 --to=prod --staged "25%:8m" --note "token-allocator fix"`

Carlos: Monitoring dashboards -> https://dashboards.internal/rc/5987 ; no anomalies.

Irene: Final: RM approves staged promo complete; will schedule full lift in next change window and publish release notes including rollback commands. Thanks everyone."
